cases.rationale: The running baseball player, dugout players and spectators are actual people; the green stadium seats have individual backs and seats, supporting chair. The runner's small hand coverings are batting gloves, not fielding mitts. A small tan/dark hand-lap object on the seated dugout player is insufficiently resolved to establish or exclude a fielding glove, so baseball glove is unclear. I considered all 75 definitions across the whole crop; the remaining categories have no identifiable qualifying objects.

Two actual giraffes have unmistakable long necks, patterned coats and horned heads among a crowd of people. The flowers are in building window boxes rather than identifiable plant pots; clothing straps do not establish a backpack or handbag. I considered each of the 75 definitions; none of the other qualifying objects is visible, and no category ambiguity remains unresolved.

The room contains a standalone television, a closed silver laptop with its recognizable lid, a small black buttoned remote on the coffee table, bound books on the left shelf, upholstered couch portions, several plants with visible pots, and a white handled drinking mug on the table. The low coffee table is not identifiable as a dining table; the closed laptop exposes no keyboard. Plant pots do not establish bowls or flower vases. All 75 definitions were considered across the crop, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual zebras are supported by clearly visible striped bodies and heads among the shrubs. The distant brown ungulate near the upper left-center is partly obscured and too small to distinguish horse from cattle or another ungulate confidently; horse and cow remain unclear. Its shape supplies no identifiable elephant or bear part. The vegetation is unpotted. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions over the whole crop; no other category has qualifying visible evidence.

A person in red flies a visible small kite with a long blue tail at the top of the crop; another distant person is at the right. Small passenger cars are recognizable on the distant road at left. The airborne object is a kite, not an actual bird or airplane, and the monument and bare trees are outside the listed object categories. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The large ornate outdoor clock has an actual circular time-of-day dial, hands, numerals and supporting clock body. Its human-shaped decorative figures are sculptures and therefore excluded from person. Building ornamentation and signs do not identify any of the other objects. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The bathroom clearly shows a pedestal sink and tap assembly, a toilet with bowl and seat behind it, and capped toiletry bottles near the left edge and bath ledge. The large fixture on the right is a bathtub, not a bed or another sink; mirrors do not establish a television, and the toiletries show no identifiable toothbrush bristles. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual giraffe crosses between two passenger SUVs, identifiable from their enclosed passenger bodies and windows. They are cars under the frozen definition rather than trucks or buses. No vehicle occupant is identifiable as a visible person through the windshields. I considered all 75 definitions, including the other animals, vehicles and roadside objects; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The pasture contains actual cattle: the foreground pale horned animal and the brown and white animals farther back have cattle body and head shapes. They do not support horse, sheep, zebra or giraffe identity. The wooden fence is neither a bench nor furniture, and the trees and grass are unpotted. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The blue-and-yellow macaw is an actual bird with visible beak, eye, feathers and gripping feet. The open metal feeding vessel attached beside its perch is a bowl, rather than a human drinking cup or a wine glass. The surrounding greenery has no visible pot evidence; cage bars and perch parts are not furniture. I considered every one of the 75 definitions and found no unresolved category ambiguity.

People stand around the pen, which contains recognizable woolly sheep; the dark animal in front is a goat and does not independently establish sheep, dog or cattle. Passenger cars are visible behind the spectators at upper left. The tall white vehicle-like side at upper right could be a truck body or a trailer, with insufficient visible cab/chassis evidence, so truck is unclear. The blue machinery does not identify a bicycle or motorcycle. All 75 definitions were considered across the whole crop.

The kitchen has a microwave with a dark door and right control panel, several narrow-necked bottles, a transparent cylindrical drinking glass used beside the utensils, and a rounded spoon bowl with a handle among the kitchen tools. Other narrow metal utensils are too small and overlapped to distinguish fork tines from a knife blade confidently, leaving fork and knife unclear. The countertop is not a dining table; the rounded box on the microwave is a breadbox rather than a second oven. No visible food is identifiable. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered.
